transforms.name: HermesGatewayNormalizer
transforms.effect: Gateway frames become session, turn, tool, conversation, and interaction events. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: recordBatch
transforms.effect: session.info running, message, and tool frames also write semantic activity. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: clarify
transforms.effect: Clarify requests become interaction:question-requested with structured questions. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: turn:failed
transforms.effect: A failed turn status becomes turn:failed. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: translateAgentEventEnvelope
transforms.effect: Maps the AgentEvent into monitor family updates. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptAgentEvent
transforms.effect: Admits the runtime-plane input. session:exited and process:exited do not clear liveness without host process evidence. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptSemantic
transforms.effect: Parses the adapter batch and stores it on the semantic plane. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: selectClaims
transforms.effect: Keeps one current claim per family key across the runtime and semantic planes. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: projectAgentMonitorState
transforms.effect: Projects AgentMonitorState from the transition basis, context, model, effort, reply, and usage. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies the projected runtime state onto the host row, applying host defaults.

transforms.name: projectBlockers
transforms.effect: Pending interactions and active failures become blockers, failure before question before permission. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

applicability.notes: No reader in list, rain, swarm, spend, timeline, or the shared toolkit words. See verification notes. No builtin consumer was proven for this field.

verification.notes: Declared status=supported. Root turn and tool activity, and the frame shape of the server→client approval request, are runtime verified; the approval shape was captured by a census client that advertises server_requests. Delivery of approval, clarify, and request.cancel to this non-advertising observer beside the attached native TUI is exact-release-source-backed (server.write_json → FanoutTransport.write; session_transports._session_client_answers_requests) but not runtime captured. Structured clarify choices and subagent activity are exact-release-contract-backed but not pinned-runtime captured. The native TUI answers approvals and clarifications and the answer never reaches this observer; an approval settles on its tool's or turn's completion, or on a request.cancel withdrawal. Loss of the gateway rail degrades observation and never proves that the attached native TUI exited. waitLine and waitBodyLine (words.ts:52-104) read kind, tool, header, question, detail, and code, not since. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
